boundary_principles.heading: trivial task 可以轻量处理，但不能越界

tasks.title: FR-001 Beacon 必须冻结 `Skill Anatomy v2`
tasks.description: Beacon 必须为关键 host-visible skills 冻结统一 contract anatomy。 该 anatomy 至少包括： Overview When to Use Boundary Workflow / Decision Loop Common Rationalizations Red Flags Verification Evidence Produced State Updated Gate Impact

tasks.title: FR-002 Beacon 必须把 anti-rationalization 提升为关键 skill 的强制内容
tasks.description: 至少以下 surfaces 必须具备显式 anti-rationalization section： `using-beacon` `beacon-prd` `beacon-change` `beacon-brainstorm` `beacon-implement` `beacon-qa` `beacon-release`

tasks.title: FR-003 Beacon 必须冻结 support surface 的统一 contract boundary
tasks.description: Beacon 必须让 guidance/support family 统一表达： not truth source not gate source not new lifecycle stage must route back to canonical truth or delivery surfaces 并且该边界不能只散落在 docs 中，而要进入 host-visible contract。

tasks.title: FR-004 Beacon 必须引入受治理的 high-risk decision challenge contract
tasks.description: Beacon 必须正式定义一个 high-risk challenge capability，用于： challenge non-trivial claims expose contradictory evidence force explicit reconcile 它的最小输出合同至少包括： claim artifact under challenge contract / expected boundary findings reconcile result stop condition route outcome

tasks.title: FR-005 Beacon 必须把 decision challenge 与 evidence/state/gate 面连接起来
tasks.description: 当 challenge 发生时，Beacon 必须能表达： 产生了哪些 evidence 更新了哪些 state 对哪些 gate 或 route 有影响 challenge 不得停留在孤立 markdown 结论层。

tasks.title: FR-006 Beacon 必须冻结 orchestration constitution
tasks.description: Beacon 必须正式说明： 哪些 surface 是 truth surfaces 哪些 surface 是 support/guidance surfaces 哪些 surface 是 execution surfaces 哪些 surface 是 gate surfaces 哪些能力只能由 main session / main router 调用 哪些能力只能做 explain / diagnose / challenge，不能 give verdict

tasks.title: FR-007 Beacon 必须把关键 anti-drift contract 提升为 machine-checkable checks
tasks.description: Beacon 至少需要设计并支持以下 checks： skill anatomy lint anti-rationalization coverage check evidence contract check state/gate trace check

tasks.title: FR-008 Beacon 必须保持 philosophy-first，而不是滑向 script-first
tasks.description: 即使 skill contract 更强，Beacon 也必须保持： decision boundary first minimum complete tools second necessary factual grounding third 不得把 public skill 普遍退化成针对强模型的逐步动作剧本。

tasks.title: FR-009 Beacon 必须允许把外部开源方法蒸馏为内部 contract，而不是 runtime dependency
tasks.description: Beacon 必须能表达： external source as research input internalized principle as frozen Beacon truth no default dependency on external repo presence

tasks.title: FR-010 Beacon 必须让 `brainstorm -> change/prd` promotion 边界更明确
tasks.description: 对于类似本次 `v1.4.6` evolution 头暴，Beacon 必须能清楚区分： 哪些内容只停留在 brainstorm / research 哪些内容应 promotion 到正式 PRD / change 避免 support-surface 研究结论长期悬空。 ## 7. 验收标准 | AC ID | 说明 | | --- | --- | | AC-001 | Beacon v1.4.6 冻结统一的 `Skill Anatomy v2` | | AC-002 | 关键 host-visible skills 具备显式 anti-rationalization sections | | AC-003 | support surface 的 non-truth / non-gate boundary 被统一写入 public contract | | AC-004 | high-risk decision challenge 的最小输出合同被正式定义 | | AC-005 | challenge 结果能映射回 evidence / state / gate impact | | AC-006 | Beacon 的 orchestration constitution 正式表达 public/support/truth/gate 分层 | | AC-007 | anti-drift contract 至少具备 lint/check 级 machine enforcement 设计 | | AC-008 | v1.4.6 没有把 Beacon 退化成 script-first skill pack | | AC-009 | 外部开源方法被蒸馏为内部 contract，而不是默认 runtime dependency | | AC-010 | `brainstorm` 到 `change/prd` 的 promotion boundary 更清楚且可执行 | ## 8. 约束与边界 仍遵守 `docs/beacon/global-boundaries.md` `brainstorm` 仍然是 read-only convergence surface `change` 仍然是 frozen truth 的正式补料/重开路由 `implement / qa / release` 不得反向重写 requirement truth learning 仍只能辅助判断，不能直接定义 truth 或 gate verdict ## 9. 风险 ### 9.1 把 skill 写得更重，可能误伤 Beacon 的轻量哲学 如果 v1.4.6 只是让 skill 变长，而不是让 contract 变清楚，结果会变成： 文档更重 用户更难读 模型仍然可能漂 ### 9.2 只写 prompt contract，不做 machine enforcement，会停留在半完成状态 如果只新增 sections，而不补 lint/check： contract 可能在新 skill 中逐步退化 维护者无法稳定检查覆盖度 ### 9.3 把外部开源“整体搬进来”会破坏 Beacon 边界 Beacon 需要的是蒸馏方法，不是引入新的公开主叙事或运行前提。 ## 10. 冻结决策 1. `high-risk decision challenge` 在 `v1.4.6` 冻结为受治理子合同，不单独升格为新的 public lifecycle surface；它必须作为 `implement / qa / release` 的 challenge capability 落地，并把结果绑定回 evidence / state / gate。 2. `Skill Anatomy v2` 在 `v1.4.6` 先强制覆盖最核心的 `using-beacon / brainstorm / change / implement / qa / release`，其余 public/support surfaces 按同一哲学对齐，但不把“全量一次性改写全部 surfaces”作为本版本前提。 3. machine enforcement 在 `v1.4.6` 先落到 release-facing / QA-facing trace checks 与现有 guardrails，确保 contract 缺口能真实阻断交付；docs lint 作为后续扩展面沿同一 contract 继续补齐，而不是本版本唯一落点。

role_semantics.team_reviewer: checks implementation/spec drift before Ralph or QA closure
role_semantics.team_tester: checks implementation evidence and verification readiness before Ralph or QA closure
role_semantics.ralph: post-freeze controller that drives next-action routing across implementation, review, qa, and release

planner.purpose: Compile execution-ready task scope from the frozen revision baseline.

implementation-architect.purpose: Translate frozen requirement truth into implementation-safe module boundaries and service ownership guidance.

implementer.purpose: Write code inside the frozen scope and the implementation architecture note.

reviewer.purpose: Review implementation/spec drift and architecture-boundary drift.

tester.purpose: Check implementation evidence and verification readiness before acceptance.

implementation_preflight: Before implementation, verify the target service belongs to: .
Before implementation, verify the current branch is beacon/v1.4.6.
If a branch switch is needed and the worktree is dirty, stop and clean or stash first.
